# Third-party font notices

MN Illuminated Codex v0.7 bundles the following fonts for offline display of the Mely Editorial theme:

- Bodoni Moda, distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.
- Gowun Batang Regular and Bold, distributed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1.

The complete license texts are included in `assets/fonts/OFL-Bodoni-Moda.txt` and `assets/fonts/OFL-Gowun-Batang.txt`.

The Mely Reference Material theme also contains user-supplied visual material and a derived background plate made for this private vault plugin. See `ASSET-PROVENANCE.md` for the file mapping.
